dimensions.assessment: Affects service members and veterans who paid into the Montgomery GI Bill and later switched to the Post-9/11 GI Bill who were previously restricted from receiving refunds if they did not receive a final housing stipend.
dimensions.evidence: ensures that the Secretary of Veterans Affairs repays members of the Armed Forces for certain contributions made by such members towards Post-9/11 Educational Assistance.

dimensions.assessment: Alters the administrative timing of financial repayments owed to eligible veterans without changing the underlying entitlement amount.
dimensions.evidence: removes the requirement for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to issue the repayments with the last monthly housing stipend

dimensions.assessment: Changes the disbursement timing of existing refund obligations rather than creating new spending or altering contribution amounts.
Amends a single section of title 38, United States Code, regarding the repayment mechanism for specific GI Bill contributors.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3327(f)(3) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking ``together'' and all that follows through ``(as applicable),''.

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent change to the VA repayment process taking effect August 1, 2025.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall take effect on August 1, 2025.

missing_information: The exact number of individuals affected or any change in total outlay timing costs.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies the timing of VA repayments for service members and veterans who contributed to the Montgomery GI Bill but chose Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits, requiring repayment before entitlement exhaustion rather than strictly with the final monthly housing stipend.
